findings.claim: A service_role key must never be prefixed NEXT_PUBLIC_; the browser bundle would contain it.
The callback redirect uses the raw next parameter without an allowlist, creating an open redirect.
findings.recommendation: Validate next starts with '/' and not '//'.

findings.claim: The plan should offer Google OAuth as well as magic links since brokers use Google Workspace.
findings.evidence: OAuth providers, MFA, session revocation UI.
findings.recommendation: Add Google OAuth in a follow-up.
